biography: Enzo Elias, a name now synonymous with audacious overtakes and flamboyant celebrations, hails from the vibrant streets of Sao Paulo, Brazil. His journey began not on a manicured racetrack, but in the chaotic world of Brazilian karting, where he honed his skills battling wheel-to-wheel against seasoned veterans twice his age. A pivotal moment arrived during the 2015 Brazilian Karting Championship where, after starting last due to a mechanical failure, Elias clawed his way to victory with a series of breathtaking maneuvers. This performance caught the eye of Kota Racing, who promptly signed him to their GT program. After a stint with Porsche, he found a home at Crown Racing, where he has become a formidable presence in the Brazilian racing scene, known as much for his raw speed as for his extravagant post-race antics. He currently aims to prove himself on a global stage.
drivingStyle: Elias is an aggressive, late-braking driver who thrives on chaos. He's known for his daring overtaking maneuvers, often diving down the inside of corners where others fear to tread. While this approach can lead to spectacular results, it also makes him prone to errors and collisions. He manages tire wear adequately, preferring short bursts of intense speed rather than a consistent, conservative pace. Under pressure, Elias tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes to his detriment, leading to risky decisions that can either win him the race or end his day prematurely.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days. Vieira, a more calculated and conservative driver, often clashes with Elias's aggressive style on track.

careerHighlight: Winning the 2021 Brazilian GT Championship after a season-long battle with his rivals, securing the title in the final race with a dramatic last-lap overtake.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the 2020 Interlagos 1000km race, a home event, due to a costly mistake in the wet, costing his team valuable championship points.
